usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.text:
_Rod, Legendary (Requires Attunement)_

The rod has 5 charges. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: _Heal_ (expends 1 charge) or _Resurrection_ (expends 5 charges).

The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the rod disappears in a harmless burst of radiance.
